findings.description: The docstring says the section is written "if at least one is documented", but the condition uses all(...), so the section is only written when every argument has help. This is also vacuously true when there are no arguments.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with two arguments, only one with help. all() is False, so the whole Positional arguments section is dropped, and the documented argument disappears from --help. Trigger 2: a command with no arguments. all([]) is True, so an empty "Positional arguments" section header is written with an empty write_dl. The old code used `if args`, which skipped the section when nothing was documented. The fix is any(...) with a non-empty guard.
